stop: Stop when het_cal, het_test, H1 and H2 (plated) shards are complete.
_doc: Plan 2c. Module types (cfcap.t1.plant wtype: mecanum, conventional/skid = roller-locked channels, omni-like = roller-axis mu x0.5). het_* = one type per assembly (mecanum or conventional); H1 = all-omni parent (unseen type); H2 = mecanum+conventional mixed in one body (unseen combination). Training is on the fly from het_train; persisted here: het_cal 10k (conformal for the type-aware models), het_test, H1, H2 5k each.
